facts.text: An economic powerhouse and major trading center in the Outer Rim, Saleucami was politically powerful during the Great Galactic War and a strategically held world within the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars.

evidence.quote: An economic powerhouse and major trading center in the Outer Rim, Saleucami was politically powerful during the Great Galactic War and a strategically held world within the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars.

facts.text: Controlled by the Techno Union throughout the Separatist Crisis, the world was liberated by the Grand Army of the Republic before the rise of the Galactic Empire and was spared the retribution demanded of other former Separatist worlds.

evidence.quote: Controlled by the Techno Union throughout the Separatist Crisis, the world was liberated by the Grand Army of the Republic before the rise of the Galactic Empire and was spared the retribution demanded of other former Separatist worlds.

facts.text: Saleucami was a dim, arid world with scattered oases of plant growth.

evidence.quote: Saleucami was a dim, arid world with scattered oases of plant growth.

facts.text: These meteors would frequently cross paths with the planet's orbit and would bombard its surface creating huge craters and calderas.

evidence.quote: These meteors would frequently cross paths with the planet's orbit and would bombard its surface creating huge craters and calderas.

facts.text: Overtime, geothermal vents and subterranean water opened up within these craters, creating circular seas and turning some calderas into life-filled pockets on the planet's surface.

evidence.quote: Overtime, geothermal vents and subterranean water opened up within these craters, creating circular seas and turning some calderas into life-filled pockets on the planet's surface.

facts.text: Ranging from desert to wetlands, the terrain on Saleucami was as diverse as its colonists.

evidence.quote: Ranging from desert to wetlands, the terrain on Saleucami was as diverse as its colonists.

facts.text: Saleucami had no indigenous sentient species, but with its pleasant climate for most of the year outside of the scorching hot equatorial regions, many settlers came to find their own oasis.

evidence.quote: Saleucami had no indigenous sentient species, but with its pleasant climate for most of the year outside of the scorching hot equatorial regions, many settlers came to find their own oasis.

facts.text: These colonists lived in tiny townships within the mineral-rich, fertile craters of the world.

evidence.quote: These colonists lived in tiny townships within the mineral-rich, fertile craters of the world.

facts.text: Establishing Taleucema as the planet's major spaceport and capital, the location was chosen for its system of subterranean magma streams and geothermal vents.

evidence.quote: Establishing Taleucema as the planet's major spaceport and capital, the location was chosen for its system of subterranean magma streams and geothermal vents.

facts.text: Harnessing the natural power of these features, the city-dwellers used the vents to power the city and provide warmth during the freezing desert nights.

evidence.quote: Harnessing the natural power of these features, the city-dwellers used the vents to power the city and provide warmth during the freezing desert nights.

facts.text: Vast tracts of woodland would be broken up by deserts and swamps, while thick jungles filled with predators appeared elsewhere.

evidence.quote: Vast tracts of woodland would be broken up by deserts and swamps, while thick jungles filled with predators appeared elsewhere.

facts.text: Based around the tenants of freedom of expression, the pursuit of happiness, and an explorer's spirit, the world blossomed on the Outer Rim, attracting many diverse species to its crater cities.

evidence.quote: Based around the tenants of freedom of expression, the pursuit of happiness, and an explorer's spirit, the world blossomed on the Outer Rim, attracting many diverse species to its crater cities.

facts.text: As more and more settlers heard of the original colonists' successes, members of other species flocked to the world to establish thriving enclaves there as well.

evidence.quote: As more and more settlers heard of the original colonists' successes, members of other species flocked to the world to establish thriving enclaves there as well.

facts.text: Overtime, the Saleucamians had developed defense systems which prevented meteor impact by blasting incoming space debris to dust before it entered the atmosphere.

evidence.quote: Overtime, the Saleucamians had developed defense systems which prevented meteor impact by blasting incoming space debris to dust before it entered the atmosphere.

facts.text: Having found much success at developing an economic hub on the Outer Rim, Saleucami's government enjoyed strong political clout within the Galactic Republic.

evidence.quote: Having found much success at developing an economic hub on the Outer Rim, Saleucami's government enjoyed strong political clout within the Galactic Republic.

facts.text: The Advozsec planned to use the Hammer Station battle station to bombard the planet but the station was eventually destroyed during a battle in Saleucami space.

evidence.quote: The Advozsec planned to use the Hammer Station battle station to bombard the planet but the station was eventually destroyed during a battle in Saleucami space.

facts.text: Repeated Republic losses, including a devastating orbital battle caused the planet's government to doubt the Republic's ability to defend its allies, and Saleucami became one of the founding members of the Rift Alliance, with the blunt-spoken Senator Alauni as its representative.

evidence.quote: Repeated Republic losses, including a devastating orbital battle caused the planet's government to doubt the Republic's ability to defend its allies, and Saleucami became one of the founding members of the Rift Alliance, with the blunt-spoken Senator Alauni as its representative.

facts.text: The actions of the third Jedi Barsen'thor convinced the Rift Alliance worlds, including Saleucami, to remain allied to the Republic, with Alauni as one of three possible candidates to represent the alliance in the Galactic Senate.
